text: I'm a childminder, looking after a little boy of 2 months overnight while his parents are away. His temp came up at 38.2 about twenty minutes ago. He's also got some blotchy pink marks on his chest. I did the glass thing and I think they went pale under it, they seemed to disappear while I was pressing and came back after. Not sure if I'm doing that test right with such a tiny one. Parents have said to ring if anything changes, so I'm letting you know first and then I'll update them.
